clause: Unified export surfaces II — PDF presets, batch/packaging, video/animation, print [STU-IO-010]

scope.summary: Implement the second StudioExportRecipe surface group: PDF export (option groups for preset/standard incl. PDF/X, general/preserve-editing, compression/downsampling, output color conversion, security, with named reusable PDF presets); batch and packaging (export each layer or artboard to individual files, artboards-to-PDF packaging); video/animation render (timeline to encoder presets or image sequences with range/size/frame-rate options); and print output (printer setup; Studio- vs printer-managed color with rendering intent + soft-proof; position + scaled print size; printing marks; bleed/background/border). Each is a StudioExportRecipe configuration; export area resolves against the canonical document/selection/slice set, not the rendered/visible subset.
acceptance_criteria: PDF presets + batch/packaging + video render + print output as StudioExportRecipe on canonical set; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: named PDF presets + batch layer/artboard-to-files + artboards-to-PDF
test: video timeline->encoder-presets/image-sequence; print managed-color + intent + marks + bleed; canonical-set resolution

target_entries: Studio / Import & Export / Export surfaces — PDF, batch, video & print

risk_if_missed: No PDF/batch/video/print export; production output gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
